verdict.rationale: GitHub documents a broad programmatic surface: a REST API for integrations and automation, a GraphQL API with flexible queries, and fine-grained token permissions mapped per endpoint. It also ships an official CLI and an official MCP server covering repositories, issues and pull requests. Nothing in the pack states or demonstrates parity between the API and the UI, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at the docs paths tried, so 'everything' is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit API-to-UI parity statement or coverage map, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed docs location, and independent hands-on confirmation that UI-only features (e.g. Copilot settings, project management) are fully API-accessible.
